extension.description: Play all your media from OneDrive including Videos, Music and Pictures. - Unlimited number of personal or business accounts. - Search over your drive. - Auto-Refreshed slideshow. - Export your videos to your library (.strm files) - Use OneDrive as a source - This program is not affiliated with or sponsored by Microsoft.
extension.summary: כונן OneDrive של מיקרוסופט עבור קודי
extension.description: הפעל את כל המדיה שלך מ- OneDrive כולל וידאו, מוסיקה ותמונות. - מספר בלתי מוגבל של חשבונות אישיים או עסקיים. - חיפוש ומציאת הכונן שלך. - ריענון מצגת אוטומטית. - ייצוא קטעי הווידאו לספרייה שלך (קבצי .strm) - שימוש ב-OneDrive כמקור - תוכנית זו אינה מזוהה עם או בחסות מיקרוסופט.

Phát mọi nội dung trên OneDrive, gồm video, nhạc và ảnh. - Không giới hạn số tài khoản cá nhân hoặc doanh nghiệp. - Tìm kiếm trong ổ của bạn. - Mở thẳng thư mục video, thư mục khởi động, danh sách video mới nhất. - Thêm thư mục video vào thư viện Kodi (tệp .strm) chỉ với một bước. - Chương trình này không liên kết với và không được Microsoft tài trợ.
extension.news:
v1.3.1: - OneDrive as a Kodi source (http://127.0.0.1:8586/source/): files now play through the relay, so they no longer stop when OneDrive's link expires, and turning the setting on takes effect without restarting Kodi.
v1.3.0: - Add videos to Favourites: a folder's videos, and its subfolders', ticked in watching order, added in one step. Existing favourites are kept. - Save as a playlist: a folder's videos as an .m3u under Videos > Playlists.
v1.2.0: - First video after Kodi starts no longer stops: the export service waits until playback ends; opening retries a cold connection; one link lookup per video. - Playback resumes after any number of dropped connections. - Add to library registers the folder as a Kodi video source with a scraper, so videos appear in Movies / TV shows by themselves. A folder of several shows becomes a source of its own. - Stream events are logged (no links) for troubleshooting.
v1.1.0: - Playback relays the video and renews OneDrive's expiring link. - One account opens straight on the drive's folders; start folder; Latest videos. - Add a folder to the library as movies or TV shows. Cached folder listings. - Vietnamese translation.
extension.disclaimer:
This add-on signs in with the OAuth 2.0 device authorization grant, directly to Microsoft. It shows you a code; you enter that code on your own phone or computer, at the Microsoft address shown beside it, and Microsoft hands the token back to the add-on.
No server run by this project, or by anyone else, sits in that exchange, and the add-on never sees your password. The application identifier it ships with is public by design: that is what this kind of sign-in uses instead of a secret, it only says which program is asking, and on its own it authorises nothing. The permission asked for is read-only access to your own files.
This program is not affiliated with or sponsored by Microsoft. Kodi and myself take no responsibility or liability.
